title: Digital elevation model of New Zealand produced with ArcGIS 9.1
credit: Wikimedia contributor Jide; based on GLOBE topography and ETOPO2 bathymetry
altText: Shaded relief elevation and ocean-depth map of New Zealand and surrounding sea floor.
caption: Digital elevation model of New Zealand generated from GLOBE and ETOPO2 datasets using ArcGIS 9.1, published in 2006.
context: This is an authentic period desktop-GIS elevation model, not LiDAR; use as an example of DEM processing and 3D terrain visualisation.
